name: Controller binary compile and exact replay
description: Exercise the shared menu through a compiled binary state and a reproducible experiment.
steps: Open Controller menu using laboratory navigation
Choose G8 binary kernel and compile source
Step G8 +1 and inspect tick 0001
Choose Reset G8 then Cancel and verify tick stays 0001
Return to categories and open G9 discovery
Run discovery and Verify exact replay
expected: Menu categories operate actual lab controls, cancellation preserves bits and tick, and discovery renders numeric evidence with Replay PASS.

name: Workspace editing and matched G6 experiments
description: Build and compare a network while keeping experiment evidence separate from live state.
steps: In controller Workspace choose Load example and confirm
Inspect two environments with internal algorithms and an external relationship
Focus an environment header and move it using arrow keys
In G6 simulation step once, run a controlled experiment and inspect the result
Select the next ablation mode and horizon, then run again
Open Evidence and notebook and export the G6 network and G6 experiment
Choose Clear workspace and cancel, confirming the network remains
expected: The graph moves with the keyboard, G6 reports measured divergence under selected controls, experiment execution preserves the live tick, exports download and cancellation retains the network.

name: Compiler controls, packets and exports
description: Verify compiler and evidence controls across independent runtimes.
steps: In controller G7 compiler compile, step and compare coupling
Choose Next G7 preset and compile it
In G8 binary kernel choose Reciprocal XOR preset and step twice
Run Test G8 causality and change the depth slice
On the page replace G8 source with MATRIX A RULE 01011010 followed by A BIT (10,0,0) = 1 and compile
Restore a valid G8 preset, add an observer interpretation on the page and run discovery
From Evidence and notebook export G7, G8 and G9 evidence
expected: G7 and G8 execute independently with visible binary instructions and packets. Invalid G8 coordinates reject execution, valid presets recover, observer labels remain external and JSON evidence downloads.

name: Mobile discovery guards and hypothesis persistence
description: Reject invalid experiments and retain an explicit observer hypothesis on mobile.
steps: Navigate to G9 and clear Ticks, then run discovery
Verify an inline error and focus on Ticks
Set 8 ticks and run each available intervention, verifying replay
Enter Observed recurrence hypothesis, set Inconclusive and save using Enter
Refresh, run a discovery experiment and inspect the notebook
Use Controller menu to navigate G8 pages with Previous and Next
Navigate to G10 composition and verify the PID gain form and binary state summary are usable on mobile
Navigate to Modular workflow and inspect the edge table without page overflow
expected: Blank required values reject the experiment and focus the invalid field. Valid paired experiments replay exactly, the hypothesis persists with Inconclusive status and the menu remains usable without page overflow.

name: PID, logo and executable modular workflow
covers: G8 to composition to G9 binary ports
description: Verify an executable PID system and real data flow between website modules.
steps: Inspect the Àtúnbí logo in the header
In G10 composition select PID regulation, step the binary matrix, compare PID with open loop and verify system replay
Select Coupled patterns and repeat the comparison and replay
Compile G8 and click Import G8 matrix in G10
In G9 select Use matrix from workflow, run discovery and verify replay
In Modular workflow disable controls-g8 and try stepping G8 from Controller menu; inspect the disconnected message
Reconnect controls-g8, disable g8-view and step G8 directly; verify the last view state is retained
Restore default wiring, save it, disable an edge and load saved wiring
Try connecting an incompatible source output to a view input
Export the wiring JSON and inspect the delivery trace
expected: The logo loads, binary cells remain 0/1, PID/open-loop measurements and exact replay appear, matrix transfers work through declared ports, disconnected edges stop delivery, compatible saved wiring reloads and incompatible wiring is rejected visibly.
